summary: One material test-quality finding: several negative tests can pass because of an existing-revision conflict rather than the intended validation. No production provenance bypass or invariant violation was established. Full pytest execution was unavailable because the available Python lacks Pydantic.

evidence: Read all of diff.patch and opened all eight changed files. Changes implement the L02 domain contract, repository admission, private snapshot inclusion, documentation and tests.
Compared changed paths with plan.md and the DEFERRED entries in tree/loop/backlog.toml; no unrelated implementation found.
tests/test_intent_v2.py:210 and :443 do not reliably prove the sealed plan's isolated rejection requirements; see R1-F1.
Executed the extracted production classifier against 104 independently enumerated chronology cases and two borrowed-seal cases. All matched the expected classes.
Executed the extracted admission function against all sixteen provenance transitions with stubbed storage; all matched the specified transition policy.
Traced IntentSpecV2 and IntentBinding registration, explicit schema_version=2, predecessor pins, digest checks and persisted reference edges through intent_v2.py and persistence.py.

Traced snapshot roots through the shared content_identity helper and refs_in dependency closure; inspected test_actual_workspace_snapshot_closure_and_frozen_export for both ordinary and alias-first bindings.
Checked admission validation for reference kinds, digest agreement, registration anchors and lineage consistency. A general lint command is explicitly outside this sealed plan.

R1-F1: tests/test_intent_v2.py:210-214 and :434-444 reuse an occupied artifact identity and accept any ValueError, allowing unrelated immutable-revision conflicts to satisfy intended validation checks.
Parsed every changed Python file and verified every post-image patch line against tree/.
Mutation checks on the extracted classifier detected relaxed chronology comparisons, relaxed first-view equality and removal of SEALED classification.
Full Pydantic, SQL concurrency and media-workspace tests were not independently executed; importing Pydantic failed with ModuleNotFoundError.
External claims at tree/loop/reports/STEP-0006-L02.md:37, :41, :45 and :49 remain pending independent source verification and are listed in claims_for_research.
Checked the thirteen weak orderings by independent enumeration and checked documentation against the implemented classifier and admission rules.
The documentation appropriately bounds local timestamps, unauthenticated evidence, legacy compatibility and unimplemented acceptability behavior.

Compared the complete diff with the sealed plan: no production seal workflow, generation-plan workflow, acceptability engine, frontend, external timestamp service or other DEFERRED implementation was added.

Checked I1-I16 against affected paths: no real judgments, UNKNOWN conversion, history overwrite, protected-file edit, measurement/decision change, averaging, confidence arithmetic, dependency/network addition, existing-test weakening, public serializer expansion or judge modification was found.
Verified that public/embed serialization remains an unchanged explicit allowlist; binding expansion is confined to private snapshots. No publication action appears in the diff.

blocking_findings.description: The repository rejection tests reuse the already persisted TEST-ONLY-intent revision 1 and accept any ValueError. If duplicate-criterion validation were removed, the duplicate-ID case would still pass because Repository.put rejects the changed payload as an immutable revision conflict. Likewise, replacing deviation dimension matching with criterion-existence checking leaves the dimension-mismatch case passing for the wrong reason. The nested-copy repository assertions have the same collision and do not establish admission revalidation independently. This violates the sealed verification requirement that otherwise-valid fixtures isolate each intended rejection.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use an unused identity or a valid next revision with its exact predecessor for each invalid candidate. Assert the intended validation error, and include an otherwise-identical valid admission control. Verify that disabling duplicate-ID validation, deviation dimension matching or copied-input admission validation causes the corresponding tests to fail.

loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Test one happy-path example per class, or obtain expected classes from the production classifier.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_every_chronology_order uses explicit ordering expectations crossed with first-view position and origin. Additional tests cover missing evidence, mismatched seals/plans, legacy intent and declarations. Independent extracted-function checks passed 104 chronology cases and detected three classifier mutations.

loophole_audit.criterion: A revision cannot borrow an earlier revision's seal.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Compare only intent IDs, or test borrowing only when no first-view timestamp could establish contemporaneity anyway.
loophole_audit.evidence: derive_provenance compares complete intent pins. test_earlier_revision_seal_cannot_establish_contemporaneous supplies a qualifying first-view time, both origins and optional plans, and checks serialized and reopened records.

loophole_audit.criterion: A revision without a reason is rejected.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Require a reason only in the authoring interface or only on successor revisions.
loophole_audit.evidence: IntentSpecV2.revision_reason is required. test_reason_is_required_on_every_path covers initial and successor revisions with missing, null, blank and unknown reasons. Its initial repository assertion has the collision weakness described in R1-F1, but constructor and successor cases independently exercise rejection.

loophole_audit.criterion: No edit can raise a record's provenance.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Protect only same-ID edits, allowing renamed bindings, cloned registration anchors or racing writers to reset the ceiling.
loophole_audit.evidence: validate_admission enforces checksum lineage uniqueness and categorical successor restrictions inside the writer transaction. Tests cover sixteen transitions, renamed bindings, aliases, changed intent, competing writers and retained historical payloads.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: context, criteria and expected deviations are validated.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Declare the fields but use rejection tests that pass because the candidate conflicts with an existing revision.
loophole_audit.evidence: The implementation contains the required validation, but test_context_criteria_and_deviations at lines 210-214 permits unrelated immutable-revision conflicts to mask missing duplicate-ID or deviation-dimension validation. See R1-F1.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: predecessor and evidence pins reject malformed references, digests and chronology.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Store reference-shaped values without checking exact revision identity, referenced digests or original registration time.
loophole_audit.evidence: predecessor, kind, utc and validate_admission enforce these boundaries. test_predecessor_must_pin_immediate_revision, test_pins_and_original_registration_reject_tampering and test_malformed_or_naive_event_times_rejected exercise them.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: provenance is computed; only FOUND may declare PROMPT_ONLY.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Accept an authored provenance label or permit GENERATED content to declare PROMPT_ONLY.
loophole_audit.evidence: IntentBinding exposes provenance as a property, restricts declaration to PROMPT_ONLY and rejects declarations for GENERATED origin. test_only_found_prompt_only_is_declarable checks the origin/class combinations and rejects a provenance input field.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: admission and snapshot membership share content identity.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Block alias promotion at admission but collect snapshots only by exact media IDs.
loophole_audit.evidence: Both validate_admission and PilotWorkspace.snapshot call content_identity. The alias-first workspace test requires the alias binding and dependencies in the selected clip's snapshot and rejects a second lineage.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: snapshots retain binding history and dependency closure.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Export only the latest binding or resolve current references when exporting an old snapshot.
loophole_audit.evidence: Snapshot roots include every relevant binding revision; traversal follows exact references. test_actual_workspace_snapshot_closure_and_frozen_export checks historical revisions, explicit dependency membership, unrelated-content exclusion and unchanged exports after revisions and reopening.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: legacy intents remain unchanged and RECONSTRUCTED.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Rewrite legacy payloads with invented v2 defaults or promote them during adaptation.
loophole_audit.evidence: LegacyIntentView is separate from persisted v1 artifacts. test_legacy_view_and_adaptation_cannot_upgrade checks unchanged payloads and digests, reconstructed classification and rejected promotion to v2.

loophole_audit.criterion: Sealed-plan contract: document provenance limits and I7 restrictions.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Describe local chronological labels as proof of generation order or as acceptability judgments.
loophole_audit.evidence: docs/intent-provenance.md explicitly distinguishes local chronology from generation-order proof and quality judgments, states the unlogged-view limitation, and documents I7 restrictions without implementing acceptability.

claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 BaseModel.model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values before creating the copied model.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another connection has an active write transaction.
RFC 3161 describes timestamping evidence that a datum existed before a particular time.
Local seal, plan, registration and first-view timestamps alone cannot prove that clip generation occurred after intent sealing; witnessing intent existence does not itself witness clip generation.

flags: Independent full-suite execution unavailable: the available Python lacks Pydantic, and the supplied folder contains no dependency environment.

The supplied gate reports 460 passing tests; that report was not treated as independently reproduced evidence.
